subject: CS471
filterSummary: Successfully selected 4 English and 3 Arabic videos. Coverage was strong for SIEM, OS Logging, and Application Logging in both languages. The highly specific 'Security Auditing Architecture (X.816)' topic had no suitable videos in either language. For 'Disaster Recovery Sites', an excellent English video was found, but all Arabic candidates failed hard gates (language, duration, or relevance).

coverage.note: The only potentially related candidate covered NIST CSF, not the required ITU-T X.816 standard, and failed the relevance gate.
No candidates found covering this specific and highly technical topic.
Candidates failed hard gates: one was in English, one was too short, and the other was not relevant enough.

videos.title: Splunk Tutorial for Beginners (Cyber Security Tools)
videos.filter_reason: This is a highly-viewed, practical tutorial on Splunk, a major SIEM tool, which directly addresses the student's struggle with complexity by showing a real system in action.

videos.title: Meet Grafana LOKI, a Log Aggregation System for EVERYTHING
videos.topic_ar: تطبيق تسجيل الأحداث في أنظمة ويندوز ويونكس
videos.filter_reason: This excellent, high-reach video provides a modern, practical approach to aggregating logs from multiple systems (including Windows and Linux), which is a core part of implementation.

videos.title: Cold Site, Hot Site, and Warm Site - CompTIA Security+ SY0-401: 2.8
videos.topic_ar: مواقع التعافي من الكوارث (الساخنة، الدافئة، الباردة)
videos.filter_reason: From a trusted educational channel, this is a concise, highly-focused, and very popular video that perfectly explains the differences between hot, warm, and cold sites.

videos.title: 12 Logging BEST Practices in 12 minutes
videos.filter_reason: A highly popular and well-produced video that directly teaches application logging best practices, including the critical balance of what to log and what to avoid for security.

videos.title: شرح سبلنك | Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Universal Forwarder (UF)
videos.filter_reason: This is a highly-viewed, practical tutorial on setting up and using Splunk, which is excellent for students needing to understand the complexities of a real SIEM system.

videos.title: طريقك لكشف الاختراق: أسرار الـ Logs التي لا يخبرك بها أحد! 🕵️‍♂️💻
videos.topic_ar: تطبيق تسجيل الأحداث في أنظمة ويندوز ويونكس
videos.filter_reason: This is the only available video that explicitly covers and compares logging on both Windows and Linux systems as requested, making it perfectly relevant.

videos.title: ماهو Logging في البرمجيات؟ شرح اهميت logging و ما فوائده بكل بساطة
videos.filter_reason: This video provides a clear and concise introduction to the concept and importance of logging at the application level, making it a great starting point for students.
